title: Pre-launch Check Finding Report
description: Machine-readable pre-launch audit findings. Defense only — no exploit payloads. Each finding should include an id, severity, non-secret evidence, a hardening fix, and a way to verify the fix.

project.description: Product or repo name under audit

rule_ref.description: RULE_ID from a playbook, e.g. CFWS-MOCK-OFF

blocking_release.description: true = must fix before public deploy / store ship

target_file.description: Primary path relative to repo root (required non-empty)

line_hint.description: Required line or range string, e.g. 120-145. Use "n/a" or "file" when exact line unknown — never null.

evidence_snippet.description: Short non-secret evidence (redact secrets; never echo live values)

instruction_for_coder.description: Concrete hardening steps for the implementer; no attack recipes

fix_constraints.description: Hard limits for the implementer: what not to change (scope, no deploy, no offensive tests). Required for every finding.

verify_command.description: Required shell, rg, or curl command to prove the fix is in place (authorized systems only; non-empty). Do not verify by attacking.

verification_status.description: Optional outcome after re-checking that the fix is in place.

verify_notes.description: Short evidence from a verify_command re-run (no secrets)

queue_tier.description: Priority band. Blocking = blocking_release true; Warning = high|medium non-blocking; Info = low|info non-blocking.

status.description: Optional finding lifecycle: still open, confirmed fixed, or rejected as a false positive.

retry_count.description: Optional count of failed verify attempts for this finding.

last_verify_exit.description: Exit code from the last verify_command run. A verified fix should have last_verify_exit === 0.
